collector_source:
"""Independently verify archived sources, actual encoded frames and original gates."""
from datetime import datetime,timezone
import hashlib,io,json,math,re,shutil,subprocess,zipfile
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image,ImageSequence
root=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2];runtime=root/'product/.runtime';dest=root/'docs/validation/evidence';public=root/'docs/assets/alpha-geometry-20261016'
def load(p):return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
def sha(p):return 'sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def decode(p,w,h,channels=3):
 r=subprocess.run(['ffmpeg','-v','error','-i',str(p),'-map','0:v:0','-an','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgba' if channels==4 else 'rgb24','pipe:1'],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=120)
 return np.frombuffer(r.stdout,np.uint8).reshape(-1,h,w,channels)
e=load(public/'evidence.json');assert sha(root/'scripts/smoke_alpha_geometry.py')==e['script_sha256']
assert sha(root/'product/src/ai_ad_editor/render.py')==e['current_render_sha256']
for name,digest in e['file_sha256'].items():assert sha(public/name)==digest,name
archive=subprocess.run(['git','-c','core.autocrlf=false','archive','--format=zip',e['baseline_ref'],'product/src'],cwd=root,capture_output=True,check=True).stdout
baseline_files={}
with zipfile.ZipFile(io.BytesIO(archive)) as package:
 for entry in package.infolist():
  if entry.is_dir():continue
  expected=package.read(entry);baseline_files[entry.filename]='sha256:'+hashlib.sha256(expected).hexdigest()
  for checkout in [runtime/'alpha-geometry-baseline',runtime/'alpha-geometry-public-20261016/baseline']:
   assert (checkout/entry.filename).read_bytes()==expected,(str(checkout),entry.filename)
assert len(e['cli_calls'])==16 and all(c['exit_code']==0 for c in e['cli_calls'])
render_calls=[c for c in e['cli_calls'] if c['argv'][0]=='render'];assert len(render_calls)==6 and sum(c['baseline'] for c in render_calls)==3
assert all('--publish' in c['argv'] for c in render_calls)
black=np.asarray(Image.open(public/'marker-black.png').convert('RGBA'));green=np.asarray(Image.open(public/'marker-green.png').convert('RGBA'))
assert np.array_equal(black[:,:,3],green[:,:,3])
selected=black[:,:,3]>0;assert np.array_equal(black[selected,:3],green[selected,:3])
assert not np.array_equal(black[~selected,:3],green[~selected,:3])
hidden={};white={};positive={}
for prefix in ['before','after']:
 a=decode(public/f'{prefix}-combined.mp4',512,288);b=decode(public/f'{prefix}-green.mp4',512,288);assert len(a)==len(b)==32
 delta=np.abs(a.astype(np.int16)-b.astype(np.int16));hidden[prefix]={'max_rgb_difference':int(delta.max()),'changed_components':int(np.count_nonzero(delta)),'mean_absolute_rgb_difference':float(delta.mean())}
 assert hidden[prefix]==e['hidden_rgb_invariance'][prefix]
 if prefix=='after':
  for i,frame in enumerate(a):
   teal=(frame[:,:,1]>120)&(frame[:,:,2]>90)&(frame[:,:,0]<100);gold=(frame[:,:,0]>160)&(frame[:,:,1]>140)&(frame[:,:,2]<135)
   positive[str(i)]={'teal_foreground_pixels':int(teal.sum()),'gold_text_pixels':int(gold.sum())}
  assert positive==e['visible_positive_controls']
 pixels=decode(public/f'{prefix}-white.mp4',512,288);error=255-pixels
 white[prefix]={'minimum_rgb':int(pixels.min()),'max_white_error':int(error.max()),'components_beyond_5':int(np.count_nonzero(error>5)),'per_frame_minimum_rgb':[int(frame.min()) for frame in pixels]}
 assert white[prefix]==e['white_on_white'][prefix]
assert hidden['after']['max_rgb_difference']==0 and white['after']['max_white_error']<=5
with Image.open(public/'alpha-geometry-comparison.gif') as gif:durations=[f.info['duration'] for f in ImageSequence.Iterator(gif)]
assert len(durations)==32 and durations==e['gif']['durations_ms'] and sum(durations)==4000
media_probe={}
for name in e['probes']:
 r=subprocess.run(['ffprobe','-v','error','-count_frames','-show_entries','stream=codec_type,codec_name,width,height,avg_frame_rate,nb_read_frames,duration','-of','json',str(public/name)],capture_output=True,check=True,timeout=90)
 probe=json.loads(r.stdout);assert probe==e['probes'][name]
 video=next(s for s in probe['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='video');audio=[s for s in probe['streams'] if s['codec_type']=='audio']
 assert int(video['nb_read_frames'])==32 and video['avg_frame_rate']=='8/1' and float(video['duration'])==4.
 assert (len(audio)==1 and audio[0]['codec_name']=='aac') if name.startswith(('before-','after-')) else not audio
 media_probe[name]=probe
provenance=load(public/'fixture-provenance.json');font=provenance['font'];assert sha(Path(font['path']))==font['sha256'] and sha(public/'font-license.txt')==font['license_sha256']
assert not list(public.glob('*.ttf')) and not list(public.glob('*.otf'))
rvmwork=runtime/'alpha-geometry-rvm-20261016';rvm=load(rvmwork/'summary.json');origin=root/'workspace/rvm-smoke-20261016-final/project';project=rvmwork/'project'
assert rvm['source_files_before']==rvm['source_files_after']
for name,digest in rvm['source_files_after'].items():assert sha(origin/name)==digest,name
assert rvm['new_model_inferences']==0 and not rvm['natural_matting_quality_accepted']
assert len(rvm['actual_cli_calls'])==5 and [c['exit_code'] for c in rvm['actual_cli_calls']]==[0,0,0,0,7]
assert not (project/'renders/blocked.mp4').exists()
v=load(project/'project.json');assets={a['id']:a for a in v['assets']};alpha=assets['person_alpha']
assert sha(project/alpha['uri'])==rvm['alpha_asset_sha256']
ledger=load(project/'rights-ledger.json');rights=next(r for r in ledger['records'] if r.get('asset_id')=='person_alpha' and r.get('active',True))
assert set(rights['derived_from'])==set(rvm['alpha_rights_dependencies'])=={'asset_20261015170909_3601a532','visual_adapter_rvm_local'}
purple=next(a for a in v['assets'] if a['uri'].endswith('purple.png'));color=np.asarray(Image.open(project/purple['uri']).convert('RGB'))[0,0].astype(np.int16)
private_rows=[{'frame':i} for i in range(36)]
for prefix in ['before','after']:
 output=project/f'renders/{prefix}-rvm.mp4';assert sha(output)==rvm['renders'][prefix]['sha256']
 frames=decode(output,640,360);assert len(frames)==36
 for i,frame in enumerate(frames):
  angle=math.radians(-15+40*i/36);x=round(320-189*math.cos(angle));y=round(180-189*math.sin(angle))
